Maker of Nexus replicants and the 2019 pyramid.

How Tyrell Corporation connects

  • Character: Eldon Tyrell — Eldon Tyrell runs Tyrell Corporation.
  • Character: Rachael — Rachael is Tyrell's experimental replicant.
  • Location: Los Angeles 2019 — Tyrell's pyramid dominates Los Angeles 2019.
  • Creator: J. F. Sebastian — Sebastian is a Tyrell genetic designer.
  • Faction: Wallace Corporation — Wallace Corporation succeeds the fallen Tyrell empire.

What is Tyrell Corporation?

Tyrell Corporation builds Nexus-6 replicants, runs the Voight-Kampff protocol, and sits in a Mayan-modern pyramid above Los Angeles.

Key threads lead to Eldon Tyrell, Rachael, Los Angeles 2019, J. F. Sebastian and Wallace Corporation.
